description: This PHP class 'LeaveStatusWithLengthDays' resides in the OrangeHRM leave module and defines a data transfer object (DTO) representing a leave status with associated length in days. It encapsulates properties like id, name, and lengthDays, along with accessor and mutator methods, including a method to add to the lengthDays value.

classes.name: LeaveStatusWithLengthDays
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating a leave status with its identifier, name, and length in days for use within the OrangeHRM leave management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the leave status with id, name, and optional length in days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of days associated with the leave status.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length in days for the leave status.

methods.name: addToLengthDays
methods.description: Adds a given number of days to the current lengthDays property.
